channel.title: Passion Struck with John R. Miles
channel.description:
Are you genuinely living, or just managing the life in front of you?
Success without physical vitality, emotional resilience, and authentic purpose is an empty pursuit. Passion Struck explores the science, psychology, and daily choices behind what it means to live fully alive.
Host John R. Miles spent decades at the highest levels of corporate leadership before walking away from the executive treadmill to discover what truly creates a meaningful, fulfilling life. Today, the bestselling author and former Fortune 50 executive brings together world-leading neuroscientists, physicians, psychologists, and behavioral experts alongside Olympic champions, professional athletes, celebrated actors, military veterans, and contemplative teachers.
Through candid, research-backed conversations and powerful solo masterclasses, Passion Struck explores how to strengthen your mental and physical health, build meaningful relationships, overcome limiting beliefs, discover your purpose, and create a life that reflects what matters most.
Join over 85 million listeners across the globe. New interviews every Tuesday and Thursday. Solo masterclasses every Friday.
Understand Yourself. Rethink Success. Live Fully Alive.
